name: revision-banner
title: Revision Banner
description: Banner for viewing an old revision: the content sits in a read-only striped frame that explains blocked edits, and "Restore this version" confirms which latest version it replaces and how many words change.

meta.stops: Edited an old version by mistake
meta.summary: Makes an old revision unmistakable and read-only, and confirms what "Restore this version" replaces before it does.
catches: Viewing an old revision, said up front with how far behind it is
Edit attempts on the old version, explained instead of silently ignored
Restore impact: which version it replaces and words changed
Restore errors, with the latest kept
limits: Read-only framing is visual and ARIA; it does not disable editors you render inside
Word-change count comes from what you pass
a11y: Banner is a region with an aria-label naming the version
Content frame is role=group with aria-readonly and an aria-label
Restore confirmation focuses Cancel first; Escape closes it
Blocked-edit note in a polite live region; errors use role=alert
